name: paytm
description: A Paytm-style digital wallet that runs entirely on your own machine. All money is simulated in a local SQLite database — no bank, UPI or payment gateway is ever contacted.

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run env:init && npm run db:setup
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:reset: npm --prefix backend run prisma:reset && npm run db:seed
